review_candidates.description: The Training Quality Specialist supports new Sales Representatives throughout the training and certification process. This role serves as a primary point of contact for trainees, helping answer training-related questions, reviewing simulated sales calls, providing targeted coaching, and monitoring trainee progress. The goal of this position is to ensure new hires receive timely support and actionable feedback while maintaining Tribe’s standards for sales quality, process adherence, and training completion. Key Responsibilities Serve as a primary point of contact for new hires during training hours, responding to questions and providing guidance on training processes, expectations, and resources. Review AI Agent simulated sales calls submitted by trainees and evaluate performance against established sales, quality, and compliance standards. Provide clear, actionable feedback following simulated call reviews. Assign and send targeted One Thing Trainings based on the most important coaching opportunity identified for each trainee. Monitor trainee progress through required training, simulated calls, certifications, and coaching assignments. Identify trainees who are falling behind, repeatedly struggling with the same skill, or may require additional support. Follow up with trainees to ensure coaching feedback has been reviewed and applied to subsequent simulated call attempts. Escalate significant performance, compliance, attendance, or training concerns to Quality & Compliance leadership. Maintain accurate documentation of trainee progress, coaching provided, and simulated call outcomes. Partner with the Quality & Compliance team to identify common new-hire performance trends and opportunities to strengthen the training experience. Performance Expectations Success in this role means trainees receive consistent, timely support and know exactly what they need to improve before progressing into live sales. The Training Quality Specialist is expected to maintain strong responsiveness during scheduled working hours, complete assigned simulated call reviews within established timelines, provide specific and actionable coaching, and proactively identify trainees who need additional intervention. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable providing constructive feedback. They should have strong written communication skills, a solid understanding of the sales process and training expectations, and the ability to balance supporting new hires with holding them accountable to established standards. This person should be approachable and encouraging while maintaining clear expectations around training completion, sales quality, and compliance. What We're Looking For 1+ year of experience in sales, sales quality assurance, call-center quality, training, or coaching. Solid understanding of the sales process, including call structure, discovery, objection handling, and closing. Experience evaluating calls or performance against a set scorecard, rubric, or quality standard. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to give clear, specific, actionable feedback. Comfortable giving constructive feedback while staying approachable and encouraging. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage many trainees, reviews, and follow-ups at once. High attention to detail and accuracy when documenting trainee progress, coaching, and call outcomes. Ability to meet set review timelines and stay responsive throughout scheduled working hours. Sound judgment about when to escalate performance, compliance, attendance, or training concerns. Comfortable with or able to quickly learn training platforms, AI-based call simulation tools, tracking spreadsheets, and messaging tools. Reliable internet and equipment are required. Because this position involves frequent phone and video calls, you’ll need a setup that can support clear, uninterrupted conversations. Available to work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time consistently. Preferred Qualifications Experience coaching or onboarding new sales representatives. Background in quality and compliance, especially in a regulated sales environment. Experience with learning management systems (LMS), CRM platforms, or call-scoring software. Familiarity with microlearning or targeted coaching methods, such as the One Thing Training approach. Experience spotting performance trends across groups and sharing insights with leadership. Join us if you’re ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

review_candidates.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: SENIOR SYSTEMS & USABILITY ENGINEER Help turn user needs into safe, effective and compliant medical devices °MEQU is growing, and we are expanding our R&D team with three new engineering positions. We are looking for an experienced Senior Systems & Usability Engineer who wants to take a central role in connecting user needs, system requirements, risk management, verification and usability engineering throughout the development of our °M Warmer System – a portable blood and IV fluid warmer used in critical care settings around the world. This is a newly created role with broad influence across the R&D value chain. You will work close to both users and technology, helping ensure that our products are not only technically robust, but also safe, intuitive and effective in real clinical environments. The position is one of three new engineering roles being added to our R&D team. You can also find the other positions on the °MEQU website and LinkedIn: ·        Senior Verification Engineer ·        Senior Electronics & Embedded Software Engineer ABOUT °MEQU At °MEQU, our mission is to empower healthcare professionals to fight hypothermia and save lives. Our °M Warmer System heats blood and IV fluids to body temperature within seconds and is used by military forces, emergency services and hospitals internationally. The product has been CE-marked since 2018 and received FDA 510(k) clearance in 2024. We are now entering the next stage of our development, scaling the company and expanding into new international markets. Our Danish office is located at Symbion, Fruebjergvej 3, 2100 Østerbro, Copenhagen. Joining °MEQU means becoming part of an experienced and highly engaged R&D team working across the full medical-device product lifecycle – from user needs and system definition through development, verification, regulatory documentation and products in the market. THE ROLE As our Senior Systems & Usability Engineer, you will help create the link between users, product requirements, technical solutions, risk management and verification. You will own and develop key systems-engineering and usability-engineering activities and deliverables, ensuring that user needs are translated into clear, traceable and verifiable requirements and that usability is addressed systematically throughout product development. The role combines structured systems engineering and regulatory documentation with practical collaboration across R&D. You will work closely with engineering, Quality and Regulatory colleagues and contribute to technical decisions, design reviews and product improvements. Because °MEQU is a growing company, you will also have the opportunity to influence how our systems-engineering and usability capabilities, processes and tools develop as the organization grows.   YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Define, structure and manage system requirements and support requirements decomposition. Translate user needs and intended use into clear, testable product and system requirements.          Maintain end-to-end traceability between user needs, requirements, risks, design outputs and verification evidence. Support system architecture, interface definition and technical decision-making across disciplines. Plan, lead and document usability-engineering activities in accordance with IEC 62366. Plan and conduct formative usability evaluations and support summative usability validation. Contribute to use-related risk analysis and ensure alignment between usability engineering and ISO 14971 risk-management activities. Prepare and maintain usability-engineering documentation and other system-level design-control deliverables. Support design reviews, design changes, verification activities and regulatory submissions. Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and relevant external stakeholders to resolve system-level and usability issues.Contribute to the continued development of °MEQU’s systems-engineering and usability processes, templates and ways of working. ABOUT YOU You are an experienced engineer who enjoys seeing the whole product rather than only one technical discipline. You can move between user needs, technical requirements, risk, documentation and practical product-development decisions. You have several years of relevant experience in systems engineering, usability engineering, medical-device development or a closely related field. Experience from MedTech is highly relevant, although strong experience from another technically complex and regulated industry may also be a good fit. Experience from a growing or changing organization is an advantage. Most important is that you are comfortable working in an environment where structures are developing and where experienced engineers are expected to contribute to how things should be done. QUALIFICATIONS We expect you to have: ·        A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline. ·        Several years of relevant engineering experience. ·        Experience with requirements engineering and requirements traceability. ·        Knowledge of design control, risk management and medical-device product development. ·        Knowledge of IEC 62366 and ISO 14971. ·        Strong analytical, technical and documentation capabilities. ·        Strong communication skills and the ability to work across technical disciplines. ·        A user-focused and quality-driven approach to product development. Experience with FDA-regulated medical devices, CE marking/MDR, usability validation, human factors engineering or formal systems-engineering methods will be an advantage.   HOW YOU WORK We believe you will thrive at °MEQU if you: ·        Are a hands-on problem solver with a structured and analytical approach. ·        Can maintain the system-level overview while still engaging with technical detail. ·        Ask the questions that connect user needs, risks, requirements and design decisions. ·        Take ownership and follow activities and documentation through to completion. ·        Proactively collaborate with colleagues across R&D and other functions. ·        Communicate complex technical topics clearly and pragmatically. ·        Are comfortable in a flexible environment where priorities and structures evolve. ·        Enjoy having influence and responsibility rather than working within narrowly defined boundaries. WHAT WE OFFER At °MEQU, you will get: ·        A key systems role in a growing international MedTech company. ·        The opportunity to work with products that make a real difference in critical care. ·        Close collaboration with highly skilled engineering and MedTech specialists. ·        Exposure to the full R&D and medical-device product lifecycle. ·        The opportunity to shape how systems engineering and usability engineering are practiced. ·        A working environment with professional ambitions, collaboration, continuous learning and a strong patient-first focus. As °MEQU continues to grow, your role may evolve with the company – and we see that as an opportunity. APPLY NOW For this recruitment, °MEQU is working with an external HR advisor. Send your CV and application to nm@nilsmunck-consult.com or apply via LinkedIn Easy Apply. If you use Easy Apply, make sure to start your CV with a section addressing your motivation for the application. For questions about the recruitment process, please contact Nils Munck at +45 5357 3274. For technical questions about the position, please contact Jesper Krogh Christensen, R&D Manager, at +45 5117 6778. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and due to the many new recruitments, it may take a while before we contact you. Even so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Join °MEQU and help us turn user needs and complex technical requirements into medical devices that are safe, intuitive and ready for use when it matters most!
